name: Demo Filer
narrative: Salaried professional (Rs 12.5 LPA) who also trades equity mutual funds. Realised Rs 18,000 short-term capital gains (111A) and Rs 1,40,000 long-term capital gains (112A) this year; some LTCG units were bought before 31-Jan-2018 so grandfathering (FMV as cost) applies. Capital gains force ITR-2. Regime choice needs an actual computation because of full 80C+80D usage under the old regime.
